purpose: Local AUTH-002 session runtime lifecycle evidence captured against the W01 Payload 3.87.1 runtime on a local miniflare D1. All tokens/passwords redacted. This is NOT remote evidence and cannot pass the CONTROLLED_REMOTE_D1 runtime validator.

runtime.command: PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore pnpm exec next dev -p 3100 (local miniflare D1 via getPlatformProxy, no remote bindings)

seed.method: Payload LOCAL API create (overrideAccess), bypasses HTTP access control

expiryDenial.method: Hand-crafted JWT signed with local PAYLOAD_SECRET (HS256), exp = now - 3600s, unknown sid

concurrency.method: Two concurrent logins for same user, separate cookie jars
concurrency.note: Payload 3.87.1 native session store allows multiple concurrent sessions; the contract's single-winner invariant is NOT natively satisfied.

singleSessionIdentity.note: W01 uses only Payload native session storage (users_sessions). No auth_session_state extension exists, matching the schema-evidence validator's accepted-absence branch.

contractGaps.impact: Runtime evidence validator requires idempotentSecondLogout === true; native Payload 3.87.1 does not provide it.

contractGaps.nativeBehavior: two concurrent logins create two valid sessions; both authenticate
contractGaps.impact: Runtime evidence validator requires singleWinnerInvariant === true; native Payload 3.87.1 is multi-session.

contractGaps.contractExpectation: auth_session_state extension correlated to native sid
contractGaps.nativeBehavior: extension table absent by design (no second session system); schema-evidence validator accepts absence, runtime validator requires the extension fields
contractGaps.impact: Schema and runtime validators disagree on whether auth_session_state must exist; cannot satisfy both without building the extension, which is forbidden.

limits: Does not pass scripts/auth-session-runtime-evidence-validate.mjs (requires remote environment and extension fields)
Contract gaps GAP-07-01/02/03 are recorded, not silently resolved
